peanut butter. Choco Mucho is a cereal crispie chocolate bar. I chose the
white and milk chocolate variants. Cloud 9 on the other hand is a slightly
chewier candy and I chose the variants of choco fudge with nougat and

peanut butter with pretzels. You may split both with Lara — or not :P.
